capabilities: Turn file links on their own line into file cards with icons, names and thumbnails
Lay out live preview blocks with the same spacing as the reading view
Show code block language names as written, in editor, reading view and PDFs
Add a search row, vault folder row and back/forward buttons to the sidebar
Draw the editor cursor rounded and thicker, Claude-style
disambiguation: Not an Anthropic Claude AI integration; it is the companion plugin for a theme named after Claude's interface style.
extras: Requires the Claude Style theme installed first and Obsidian 1.15+; the plugin and theme share one version number and must match. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the plugin uses no network, collects nothing and changes no notes.
intentEvidence: The optional plugin for the Claude Style theme.
motivation: The author states that a theme can only change how Obsidian looks and a few things need code, so this plugin adds those for the Claude Style theme.
problem: A theme can only change how Obsidian looks with CSS, but some visual behaviors like file cards and reading-view block spacing require code.

relations.evidence: The optional plugin for the Claude Style theme.

summary: Companion plugin for the Claude Style theme that adds what CSS alone cannot do, such as file cards and reading-view-like spacing in live preview.
